name: Argentina
shortSummary: Argentina and India share historic non-aligned solidarity and a growing critical-minerals relationship, with Indian public-sector firms investing in Argentina's lithium reserves for battery supply chains.

majorAreasOfCooperation.description: Indian investment in Argentine lithium reserves supports India's electric-vehicle battery supply chain ambitions.
Argentina is a significant supplier of soybean oil to India.

recentDevelopments.title: Lithium investment continues
recentDevelopments.description: Indian public-sector investment in Argentine lithium blocks continued as part of India's critical-minerals strategy.
recentDevelopments.whyItMatters: Positions Argentina as an increasingly important supplier for India's electric-vehicle battery supply chain.

historicalEvents.title: Strategic Partnership
historicalEvents.description: India and Argentina elevate ties to a Strategic Partnership.

historicalEvents.title: Lithium Mining Investment
historicalEvents.description: An Indian public-sector consortium (KABIL) secures stakes in Argentine lithium blocks to secure battery-grade mineral supply.
